en.title: Civet · Behavior review
en.intro: Watch each clip and record the behaviors and time ranges you observe yourself.
en.guide1: Watch the whole clip once. Seek to the start of a behavior, then click 1. Mark start.
en.guide2: Play or seek to its end, then click 2. Mark end. Choose a behavior and give a reason if uncertain.
en.guide3: Repeat for the remaining intervals. Check the table, then click Save clip and continue. The green status confirms saving.
en.draftGuide: Drafts are stored automatically in this browser. They are not submitted until you save the clip. Stop the terminal with Ctrl+C when finished.
en.stepStart: Seek to the start of a behavior, then click step 1.
en.stepEnd: Start: {time} s — play or seek to the end, then click step 2.
en.stepChoose: 3. Choose a behavior for this interval, then mark the next interval.
en.mediaGuide: If MP4 does not play in Fedora/Firefox, check your system codecs or open this URL in a browser that can play MP4. Your saved answers remain in the same file.
en.reasonPlaceholder: For example: animal hidden from view
en.empty: No intervals yet. Seek to a behavior's start and click Mark start, or add an interval manually.
en.shortcuts: Optional shortcuts outside input fields: Space play/pause · N add · Left/Right select interval · 1 Eating · 2 Locomotion · 3 Resting · 4 Climbing · 5 Transition · 6 Uncertain · R reason · D delete · Enter save clip
en.restingRule: Resting requires at least 5 continuous seconds of inactivity. Once confirmed, mark from the start of inactivity. Use Uncertain with a reason when the evidence is insufficient.
en.draftSaved: Draft stored in this browser · not yet saved to file
en.draftUnavailable: Not saved · draft storage is unavailable in this browser
en.draftRestored: Draft restored · check it before saving
en.draftError: Could not read the draft. Please check the intervals again.
en.complete: All clips reviewed — your answers have been saved.
en.blind: BLIND — no existing answers or machine proposals are shown
en.finishPending: Finish the interval you started before adding another one.
en.seekBeforeEnd: Seek to a position before the clip ends, then add an interval.
en.startBeforeEnd: The start must be before the end of the clip.
en.endAfterStart: The end must follow the start. Seek forward in the video.
en.mediaError: Video playback failed. See the help below the interval buttons.
en.pendingSave: An interval is missing its end. Complete step 2 before saving.
en.needInterval: Add at least one interval before saving.
en.invalidTime: Check the interval times: the end must follow the start and both must be within the clip.
en.needReason: Give a reason for every Uncertain interval.
en.overlap: Intervals overlap. Adjust their boundaries before saving.
en.saveError: Saving failed; your intervals are still on this page: {error}
en.Resting: Resting — continuously inactive for at least 5 seconds
en.Climbing: Climbing — movement along a sloped or vertical structure
en.Uncertain: Uncertain — insufficient evidence or obscured view
en.conditionsHelp: Choose all four conditions for every interval. Cannot determine is an explicit choice, never a default. Elevated oblique means a camera looking down at an angle; it does not identify the camera.
en.editMode: EDIT SAVED ANSWERS — only your saved intervals are loaded; this is not a new blind pass
en.condition_clear: Clear — animal and relevant action visible
en.condition_partial: Partial — only part of the animal visible
en.condition_out of view: Out of view — outside the image
en.condition_elevated oblique: Elevated oblique — looking down at an angle
en.condition_enclosure structure: Enclosure structure — ledge, log, wall or frame
en.condition_animal-level side view: Animal-level side view — looking horizontally from the side
en.notesPlaceholder: Additional observations or a note about interval boundaries

th.title: Civet · ตรวจพฤติกรรม
th.intro: ดูวิดีโอ แล้วบันทึกพฤติกรรมและช่วงเวลาที่คุณสังเกตเอง
th.quickStart: เริ่มครั้งแรก? ดูวิธีใช้งาน 3 ขั้นตอน
th.guide1: ดูคลิปให้จบหนึ่งรอบ เลื่อนไปจุดเริ่มพฤติกรรม แล้วคลิก 1. กำหนดจุดเริ่ม
th.guide2: เล่นหรือเลื่อนไปจุดจบ แล้วคลิก 2. กำหนดจุดจบ เลือกพฤติกรรมให้ช่วงนั้น หากไม่แน่ใจให้ใส่เหตุผล
th.guide3: ทำจนครบช่วงที่ต้องการตรวจ ตรวจตาราง แล้วคลิก บันทึกทั้งคลิปและไปถัดไป สีเขียวบอกว่าบันทึกแล้ว
th.draftGuide: ฉบับร่างเก็บในเบราว์เซอร์นี้อัตโนมัติ แต่ยังไม่เป็นคำตอบในไฟล์จนกดบันทึก ปิด terminal ด้วย Ctrl+C เมื่อเลิกใช้งาน
